annotations.title: Find a class to drop in

description: Classes open to visitors right now at Gymmy gyms that accept drop-ins from anywhere (trial, single class or class pack), near a place or point, optionally one day or one kind of class ('hyrox', 'yoga'). Each result has the gym, class_id, date, spots left, the cheapest price and the offers that book it (offer_id). Book one with book_dropin.

class.description: Kind of class or coach to match, e.g. 'WOD', 'HYROX', 'Yoga'.

gym.description: Only this gym (Gymmy id from search_gyms).

query.description: Place to search around: address, district, city or postcode ('Lyon 7', 'Bastille'). Geocoded when no lat/lng is given.

radius_km.description: Radius in km, 1 to 50. Default 15, or fitted to the place.

name: search_classes
title: Find a class to drop in
